title: Motion card morph
caption: The motion-card-morph recipe: one shape never cuts. A dot springs into a headline pill, the pill opens into a card whose rows land on a stagger, then folds into a control the cursor clicks.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6 second 16:9 clip for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-card-morph style only: a pill titled "What Magnifito does" opens into a card with four rows (websites, social media, email and ads, automation), then becomes a control the cursor clicks. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.
